$why: The headings that label precomputed evidence for the review-ranger and mutant-hunter gates, and the truncation notice that goes with a source file longer than the window. That notice is prompt text of the most consequential kind: it is the only thing telling an agent that what it is judging is incomplete.
description: Headings that label precomputed evidence for the QA gates, and the notice shown when a file is truncated.
